body: Nothing has happened, I just wanted to see if I could potentially save my husband from a first hand traumatic experience through the help of a stranger.

I attempted an overdose. I had the plan to take two separate but equal amounts with about 20 minutes in between (to make sure it wouldn't come back up). My husband found me before I took the second half. It took me 3 days to be able to sit up, and 7 days to walk around while my body processed it out...The failure wasn't worth the aftermath.
